description: Vs. CPU Mode on blank cards won with no poke: versus-cpu-first-fight's menu inputs, then P1 (KANNUKI) CROSS every 20 frames from 8360 to 20980 and TRIANGLE / CROSS alternating every 20 frames from 21000 to 23160. fight_AdvanceOpponentOrder stores the counter D_800A3783 1 at the load and 2..5 after the first four kills (9282, 14441, 19202, 20881); fights that end with no kill (three against the second opponent, one against the fifth) go through the post-KO menu's Rematch row (the CROSS presses). After the fifth kill (23354) it finds D_800A3783 == D_800A391F and stores mode 0x20 (17AFC.c:5435), so fight_InitRotatingViewDecimalPresentation / fight_UpdateRotatingViewDecimalPresentation draw 5 Kills Completed! for 151 passes with no input (2B344.c:969-997), then the top menu. The retail route to event:vs_cpu_clear (versus-cpu-clear pokes the counter instead)
